findings.evidence: Direct comparison of Extreme.lean:64-101 with Extreme.lean:111-144; both use `ProbabilityTheory.map_eq_iff_forall_finset_map_restrict_eq` and `Equiv.Perm.exists_finite_compl_fixedBy_apply_eq_on_finset` (TauCeti/Algebra/GroupAction/FiniteSupportPerm.lean:238) with identical surrounding plumbing.
findings.fix: Extract the shared finite-marginal argument as one private lemma, e.g. `private theorem map_pairReindex_eq_of_forall_finset {ρ} [IsFiniteMeasure ρ] {σ τ : Equiv.Perm ℕ} (h : ∀ F : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), ∃ σ' τ', ρ.map (pairReindex σ' τ') = ρ ∧ ∀ p ∈ F, σ' p.1 = σ p.1 ∧ τ' p.2 = τ p.2) : ρ.map (fun x : ℕ × ℕ → α => fun p => x (σ p.1, τ p.2)) = ρ.map fun x p => x p`, and derive both theorems from it: the separate case supplies the two approximations directly, the joint case supplies one approximation on `F.image Prod.fst ∪ F.image Prod.snd` with `σ' = τ'`, its invariance coming from `SMulInvariantMeasure.measure_preimage_smul` rewritten by `finitaryPerm_smul_array_def` (Ergodic.lean:72) as at line 83-91.
findings.issue: `separatelyExchangeable_of_finitary` (lines 111-144) duplicates the proof of `jointlyExchangeable_of_smulInvariantMeasure` (lines 64-101) step for step: same `hmeas` AEMeasurability block, same `ProbabilityTheory.map_eq_iff_forall_finset_map_restrict_eq` framing (lines 72/120 and 92/135), same `Equiv.Perm.exists_finite_compl_fixedBy_apply_eq_on_finset` approximation (lines 76/124-127), same `heq` + `Finset.restrict_def` endgame (lines 94-101/137-144). Only the approximating finsets (`F.image Prod.fst ∪ F.image Prod.snd` vs. the two images separately) and the source of the finitary invariance differ.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:266-275 states the iff for arbitrary `X`; instantiating `X := fun p x => x p` with `hX := fun p => (measurable_pi_apply p).aemeasurable` yields `(ρ.map fun ω p => ω p).map (pairReindex σ τ) = ρ.map fun ω p => ω p`. Basic.lean:303 already closes exactly this eta-expanded identity map with `Measure.map_id'`.
findings.fix: Prove it by reuse: `⟨measurable_pairReindex σ τ, by simpa using (separatelyExchangeable_iff_map_pairReindex (fun p => (measurable_pi_apply p).aemeasurable)).mp hρ σ τ⟩` (`Measure.map_id'` is `simp`, so both `ρ.map fun ω p => ω p` occurrences collapse to `ρ`), and drop the `hfun`/`show ... = id from rfl` block and its comment.

summary: New material is genuinely new and the Decomposition.lean factoring is good reuse, but separatelyExchangeable_of_finitary is a line-by-line clone of jointlyExchangeable_of_smulInvariantMeasure five lines above it, and two new proofs re-derive the identity-map step that Mathlib's Measure.map_id' already states (and that this repo already uses for the same eta-expanded map).
